v2FeatureSemantics.name: heading_net_change_abs_rad
v2FeatureSemantics.discards: turn sign, oscillatory path length, and unreliable heading intervals

v2FeatureSemantics.name: heading_turn_consistency
v2FeatureSemantics.formula: abs(signed_heading_sum)/sum(abs(heading_delta)) with zero for a tiny denominator

v2FeatureSemantics.name: sustained_turn_fraction
v2FeatureSemantics.formula: count(intervals with abs(turn_rate)>=0.20 rad/s and dominant sign)/valid_interval_count
v2FeatureSemantics.retains: interval-count support for sustained dominant device rotation
v2FeatureSemantics.discards: dominant sign, exact rate magnitude, and time-weighted duration

v2FeatureSemantics.name: arcore_straightness_ratio
v2FeatureSemantics.discards: lateral side, turn direction, and direct cross-track deviation

v2FeatureSemantics.name: arcore_net_turn_abs_rad
v2FeatureSemantics.discards: turn sign and absolute accumulated curvature

v2FeatureSemantics.name: arcore_curvature_abs_rad_per_m
v2FeatureSemantics.discards: net direction, heading/path agreement, and chord-relative lateral deviation

turning.interpretation: Turn evidence is sparse and concentrated in a few two-second windows; dilution is consistent with the aggregates but cannot be causally proven without raw intra-window history.

features.name: heading_signed_net_turn_rad
features.algorithm: clamp(sum(wrap_pi(heading_i-heading_i_minus_1)),-2*pi,2*pi) over reliable heading samples in the same trailing 2 s window
features.purpose: preserve device-heading turn direction for cross-source comparison

features.name: arcore_signed_net_turn_rad
features.algorithm: clamp(sum(wrap_pi(path_bearing_i-path_bearing_i_minus_1)),-2*pi,2*pi) for consecutive horizontal segments of at least 0.03 m in the same trailing 2 s window
features.purpose: preserve trajectory-turn direction for cross-source comparison

features.name: heading_path_turn_direction_agreement
features.algorithm: 0 if min(abs(h),abs(a))<0.20 rad; otherwise sign(h*a)*min(1,min(abs(h),abs(a))/0.35), where h and a are features 35 and 36
features.purpose: separate same-direction physical turns from opposing or unsupported device/path rotation

features.name: heading_path_turn_magnitude_difference_ratio
features.purpose: expose phone-only heading rotation or path-only turning without division by a tiny value

features.name: heading_path_turn_coherence
features.purpose: provide conservative joint turn evidence that is high only when both sources are strong, sustained, consistent, and same-direction; minimum avoids multiplicative noise attenuation

features.name: arcore_cross_track_rms_m
features.algorithm: retain the first tracked point and each later point at least 0.03 m from the last retained point; when at least three points and a chord of at least 0.05 m exist, compute RMS perpendicular distance of retained intermediate points from the first-to-last chord and clamp to [0,5] m
features.purpose: detect broad or shallow trajectory curvature that end-to-end/path-length ratio can understate

crossSourceAgreement.reason: Heading and ARCore path bearings use the same ENU angular convention, and a constant body/device offset cancels in signed changes. Absolute device-heading versus path-bearing delta remains risky because device yaw is not guaranteed to equal walking direction.

trajectoryGeometry.reason: RMS uses the whole retained path and is less single-frame-sensitive than maximum deviation.

multiScale.reason: A trailing 4 s summary can retain pre-transition turn evidence for several hops and, when combined with a bounded decoder, can recreate the latency problem. Test direct 2 s cross-source representation first.

dataCollectionPlan.justification: Five independent sessions per class is the minimum balanced target for grouped five-fold development CV; start with two targeted smoke sessions before incurring the remaining collection cost.

recommendationReason: Bounded decoding meets latency but not session robustness, added MLP capacity improves aggregate metrics without closing the worst-fold gap, and V2 discards the signed cross-source relation needed to distinguish phone rotation from physical turning.
